summary: This standards-track document describes a YANG data model for the Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol. It covers both version 2 and version 3 of VRRP. Operators can use it to configure and monitor VRRP in a standard way.

eli5.summary: If one helper goes home, a backup takes over so work never stops. This is a standard form for setting up and checking those backup helpers on routers.
